about.en: Automata Network builds attestation infrastructure that uses trusted execution environments (TEEs) to let Ethereum and rollups verify off-chain machines, including a multi-prover TEE coprocessor for rollup security. ATA is its ERC-20 token at 0xA2120b9e674d3fC3875f415A7DF52e382F141225 on Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain, used for governance and staking in the network.
